Workbenches, built your way

Made to your size and your height from square tube steel. Every weld gets a coat of cold galvanising, free of charge.

Custom workbenches

Any length, width and working height. Cross rails, a lower shelf or foot rail, whatever your bench needs. Ready for your own top.

Built from your design

Send me a design with sizes and I will build to it. A sketch, a drawing or a photo of something you have seen online all work.

I build benches and bench fittings only. I do not make carts or frames for machinery, as they are too large and heavy. All work is non-structural. If a job ever needs a certificate, I will tell you up front.

Add-ons for your bench

If you have seen it on a bench online, there is a good chance I can build it.

  • Slide-out drawers
  • Grinder disc holders
  • Tool holders and racks
  • Shelves and lower rails

Recent work

A few jobs straight off the bench.

Built to hold weight

Every weld is checked by eye for porosity and defects before it leaves the shop, so each frame can carry a heavy load.

Every weld gets a coat of proper cold galvanising, free of charge. It is all done in-house and you deal with the person who built it.

How it works

Simple, in writing, and no surprises.

  1. Send me your design

    Sizes, a sketch or a photo, and what you want on it. Quotes are free.

  2. Get a quote

    I will come back with a price and what is included.

  3. Sign the contract

    You and I both sign a contract that spells out the work. Payment is made before delivery or pickup.

  4. I build it

    Cut, welded and coated in my South Brisbane workshop, then delivered or picked up.

Free delivery on benches smaller than 1100 x 1400 mm, within 50 km of South Brisbane. Anything larger is pickup, or I can deliver for the cost of fuel and trailer hire.
